name: Basil
description: Basil (Ocimum basilicum) — a annual herb suited to windowsill, indoor and outdoor cultivation.

careNotes.note: Start from seed or cuttings; keep humidity high until rooted.
Pinch growing tips to encourage bushiness and delay flowering.
Allow slight dry-back between waterings; most herbs resent wet feet.
Verified: PLOS ONE modeling study — sweet basil branching increases with mean daily temperature 23→35 °C and DLI 5.5→13.2 mol/m²/d; keep ≥14 DLI for compact high-yield growth.
